method: North-up satellite kerb trace, calibrated with right-click coordinates at pixels (840,615) = (53.648870,-3.004744) and (1000,550) = (53.648922,-3.004530), in a 1600x1100 capture. Converted to the existing London Square frame; checked against Occulo ground corner, not displaced roof edge. Street View confirms corner railings, buff crossing landings, red borders and offset signal posts. Satellite capture date unavailable.
uncertainty: Kerbs approximately +/-0.4m; rail setback, panel sizes, crossing lengths and furniture positions are photographic estimates. Outer ends taper to existing corridor seams, pending a broader Lord Street kerb survey. No survey precision claimed.
